answer: Each attempt carries 95 stamped dockets, each costing £9 to have checked, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. To join, a name must pass Mottobound crimson limner arms charter, which works because a charter crimson limners hold after herald office inspections. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. The yarrow is checked, not assumed. One river, one entry. Every sonnet is counted once.
